config.catalogToggleTooltip: Model catalog (models.json): the data source for the Codex desktop model list. Enabling it generates and activates the catalog, after which model/provider changes sync automatically; disabling it restores the built-in model list on desktop (the file is kept).
config.currentSubtitle: Only model-related fields are managed; everything else is left untouched
config.skipLoginTooltip: Restricts the auth method to API key (writes preferred_auth_method + forced_login_method); with a custom provider this avoids ChatGPT login. Note: it does not provide credentials — if a failed login left an invalid ~/.codex/auth.json, delete it and restart the client.
config.currentEmpty: Not set. Click the star on a model below to switch.
config.emptyProviders: No Codex custom providers detected. Add one to use third-party models via DeepSeek's official integration.
config.deleteProviderConfirm: Delete provider {id} and its model list? The API Key in config.toml will also be removed.
config.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Add one and click its star to make it current.
config.providerIdHint: Maps to [model_providers.<ID>] in config.toml; letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
config.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the ID
config.apiKeyHint: Written in plaintext to config.toml as in DeepSeek's official integration. Make sure ~/.codex/ permissions are secure.
config.editIdHint: Renaming also syncs model_provider references and the model list
config.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved; leave empty to keep the current Key
config.fetchHint: Fetched from the provider's Base URL /models endpoint; you can also type one manually
config.resetWarning: The following model-related settings written by CCConfig will be removed. This cannot be undone:
config.resetNote: Other config.toml settings (mcp_servers, profiles, etc.) are unaffected. Restart the Codex client afterward to return to the official defaults and sign in again.
config.resetSummaryCatalog: Model catalog reference model_catalog_json (models.json is kept in ~/.codex/)
config.resetSummaryProviders: All custom providers ({count} total, including saved API Keys)
config.resetSummaryLogin: Login info ~/.codex/auth.json (Codex will need to sign in to ChatGPT again next time)

provider.clearKeyConflict: The Key deletion box is checked. Clear the Key field or uncheck it.

catalog.enabled: Model catalog enabled ({added} added, {updated} upgraded, {total} total). Model changes will now sync automatically.
catalog.disabled: Model catalog disabled; the desktop app is back to its built-in model list (models.json is kept).

effort.authEnabled: API Key auth enabled (ChatGPT login skipped)

reset.done: Default config restored. Restart the Codex client to apply.
